title: Airbnb: Strangers in Your Home
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Airbnb: Strangers in Your Home.

hook.text: Brian Chesky couldn't afford rent. He put air mattresses in his living room for conference guests.

buildup.text: Airbnb let anyone rent out a spare room or entire home to travelers worldwide.

discovery.text: Reviews, photos, and identity verification made people trust sleeping in a stranger's home.

twist.text: Cities fought back with regulations. Airbnb disrupted not just hotels, but housing markets.

climax.text: Airbnb proved that trust and design could turn any home into a hotel room.

punchline.text: Air mattresses launched a hospitality empire.

quiz.question: How did Airbnb start?
options: Renting air mattresses during a conference
